_readme: Engine defaults, method-neutral. Layered under: methods/<m>/method.json defaults <- knowledge packs <- <project>/engagement.json <- <run>/run.json. Do not put client data here.

models._readme: Semantic model profiles. engine/defaults/model-profiles.json resolves each profile to a pinned provider model and reasoning effort when the brief is rendered. A run may override a role or profile under model_overrides without changing the workflow.

activity._readme: Live agent activity: the PreToolUse hook writes one line per sub-agent tool call to state/ACTIVITY.jsonl. An agent in flight without a sign of life (activity or output write) for stall_minutes shows as stalled on the dashboard and in `dbcx status verify` / `status inflight list`; A call still running (PreToolUse without its PostToolUse, e.g. a build) counts as busy, not stalled, up to max_call_minutes. The orchestrator decides what to do, nothing restarts on its own.

scoring._scoring_readme: Incremental gauntlet: from round 2 the critics score only new/changed claims (hash of statement+evidence+target); unchanged claims that passed keep their score (score_aggregate carries it forward). Register frozen after freeze_register_after_round: later rounds fix, they do not add. Light pass: scopes the method's discover tool marks light (size < light_pass_size or method rule) or listed in light_pass_scopes; skip_scopes are not analysed at all. A verdict `false` (and `unsupported` with counter-evidence when block_unsupported_with_counter_evidence) blocks a pass regardless of score; a below-threshold share above max_below_threshold_share fails; a cross-critic spread >= critic_divergence_flag on one claim becomes an issue even on PASS; light-pass scopes run the light gauntlet (max_gauntlet_rounds_light rounds, critic_client_light); the client critic opens carried_evidence_sample evidence cells of carried claims per round. Atomic claims: md_to_json warns when a statement exceeds claim_max_statement_chars, carries more than claim_max_figures figures or names more than one target - one proposition, one figure with its basis, one sheet per claim; the incremental gauntlet then re-scores one atom instead of a paragraph.

retrieval._readme: corpus retrieval, chosen by the engine and the agents and never shown to the user. A unit whose mapped share of the corpus (state/RETRIEVAL.json) fits read_budget_tokens is read in full (strategy read), a larger one is worked search-first (strategy search). PROVISIONAL: 60000 is a first guess until the retrieval spike calibrates it on real corpora. Optional: topics (words added to every unit's map query), boost {"<scope>|*": [SRC id | input path prefix]} (sources always mapped to that unit).

human_input._readme: Rulings intake and batched questions. release = live | batched: batched stores every question `dbcx questions add|import` registers with released false - the dashboard and the workbooks show released questions only, `dbcx questions release` releases a batch at a wave gate or phase end (`dbcx status next` prints it), and a final build refuses while one is unreleased. rulings = optional | required: required holds the first wave in `dbcx status next` until `dbcx rulings done|skip`; optional prints a recommendation line only.

claims._readme: Quote gate: quotes = off | warn | required. warn: `dbcx evidence quotes` checks every filled `quote` column against its locators and extract_claims shows the result in the critic pack (only when a claim carries a quote); required: every claim is checked, a fact claim whose quote is not found is a blocking defect and a claim without a quote counts toward scoring.max_imprecise_share (score_aggregate).

lint._readme: dbcx lint_deliverable: process and versioning vocabulary that must not reach a client workbook (regex, case-insensitive) - a client sees one version-free deliverable that speaks about their landscape, requirements or technology, never about rounds, corrections, reviewers or earlier versions; allow_terms are domain phrases that are fine. Judgement columns are labelled '(assessed)' vs '(formula)' - never '(analyst)'.

rules.web_lookups: only external standard documentation with generic queries (no client name, no scope names, no locators of internal evidence bases)
